_comment: Raw Voyage rerank-2.5 relevance scores recorded from production (api.crosmos.dev) on 2026-08-19 to calibrate RERANK_RELEVANCE_FLOORS. Each entry is one /search call with recency_bias=0, so the reported score is the model's relevance with no recency/temporal boost applied -- the same value the floor is compared against. 'gold' are the memories that genuinely answer the query, 'noise' are the rest. Corpora: 37-memory and 19-memory labeled spaces plus a 1-memory space reproducing the reported single-memory false-positive.
